_comment: Locations. id is added to LOCATION_ID_BASE and never reused (retired: 4, a pickup found inside a building that opens later, 2026-09-24). source says how the game marks it done: an EventControl event plus the global flag it sets (see agent_docs/MEASURED.md). The client sends a check when that flag becomes true. source.give, where known, is the |giveitem,type,item,...| that hands out the vanilla item on that map (type -1 berries, 0 item, 1 key item, 2 medal): the client keeps it out of the inventory and shows the seed's item instead. source.pickup is an item lying in the world (or buried in a dig spot): its flag is the pickup's own activationflag (agent_docs/MEASURED.md, "World pickups"), type is the item kind (0 item, 1 key item, 2 medal) and item its id; the client knows it by map and flag. Artifacts are events (no id): the game counts 7 artifact flags, and the goal is having enough of them. A location's requires lists event or item names it needs beyond its region. story_events are logic-only events (no id): a story step, placed in the region where it happens, whose item other rules require. requires is what the spot itself needs once you're in the room (the user, 2026-09-24: kept apart from what reaching the room needs, so entrance rando can change the second without touching the first); written even when the region already implies it. category marks a location a yaml option can leave out (quest: shuffle_quests; crystal_berry: shuffle_crystal_berries). A story pickup (pickup.story: no activationflag of its own; its story event hides it for good) is known by the story event picking it up starts, source.event (the pickup's data[1]; the same whether the scene or the map made it), and its check is the flag that event sets; an option that skips that event can leave the location out. kept_open lists blockers the story puts up for a while (map, entity name); the client keeps them out of the way so an area with locations never closes (the user, 2026-09-24). A location may be marked done by a number slot instead of a flag: source.var and source.at_least (flagvar[var] reaching at_least), sent in slot_data as location_vars. A crystal berry location has source.berry, its crystalbflags index (no flag); sent in slot_data as location_berries. A respawning location has source.regional (its regional flag) instead of a flag; sent inside location_pickups. kept_present lists entities the story only makes later (map, entity name); the client makes them exist from the start, so a way stays open (the user, 2026-09-25: open world by default, one gate at a time).
